description: The long one nobody else wants: parcel through the Threshold to Castoff Walk, on to the Marquee, and all the way to Cathode Row before you turn back. It pays because it's a hike. 25₵.
name: The Long Haul

emotes: {who} hauls the load through the Threshold, arms already burning.
{who} grunts, hikes the load higher, and keeps moving.
{who} pauses at the Threshold just long enough to resettle the load.
{who} keeps hauling on to Castoff Walk, cursing whoever decided this needed doing on foot.
{who} switches the load to the other shoulder without breaking stride.
{who} trudges toward Castoff Walk, sweat running into their eyes.
{who} drags the load past the Marquee, sweating, refusing to put it down.
{who} staggers past the Marquee, arms shaking.
{who} mutters that this is the last job board gig they ever take.

objectives.desc: All the way to Cathode Row
emotes: {who} finally hauls it all the way to Cathode Row and drops it with a groan.
{who} sets the load down at Cathode Row and doesn't move for a second.
{who} collapses against a wall at Cathode Row, load finally delivered.
